title: The Army Plans to Blow Up Tons of Toxic Explosives in Iowa. It Rejected a Safer Option.
summary: The Army had hired a firm to turn the explosives into harmless waste, but then dropped it in favor of a controlled blast that could launch lead dust across Iowa.
